clues: Whoever ran the choir took a photo later than whoever wore the red coat.
Between them, Gideon and Hattie took the 7:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m. photos.
The volunteer in the navy coat ran either the choir or the lanterns.
Whoever handled the tickets wore either a gray or a camel coat.
Wren took her photo exactly half an hour after the volunteer in the green coat took theirs.
One of Lena and Gideon ran the tickets, and the other ran the choir.
Wren and the cocoa volunteer are two different people: one took the 9:00 p.m. photo, the other the 8:30 p.m. one.
Lena took her photo earlier than the volunteer in the camel coat.
Wren took either the 7:00 p.m. or the 8:30 p.m. photo.
hints: Look at Wren in clues 5 and 9. Which of her two times leaves room for someone in green half an hour earlier?
Use two clues together: clues 5 and 9 place Wren, then clues 2 and 8 place Lena. When the clues stall, test Wren's job: only two remain.
Suppose Wren ran the banners. Then Hattie ran the lanterns in red, clue 3 puts navy on the choir, and the 8:00 p.m. green coat has no job.
With Wren on the lanterns, Hattie ran the banners and wore red. Red came before the choir (clue 1), so Hattie took the 7:00 p.m. photo.

solution.key_idea: Supposing Wren ran the banners puts Hattie on the lanterns in red and navy on the choir, leaving the green coat no job.
steps: Clue 5 keeps Wren off 7:00 p.m., so clue 9 puts her at 8:30 p.m., and the green coat at 8:00 p.m.
Clue 2 gives 7:00 and 8:00 p.m. to Gideon and Hattie, and clue 8 keeps Lena off 9:00 p.m. So Lena took 7:30 p.m.
So Teddy took the 9:00 p.m. photo, and by clue 7 he ran the cocoa.
Clues 6 and 1 put the choir at 7:30 or 8:00 p.m. So red, earlier than the choir (clue 1), was neither Wren's nor Teddy's.
Suppose Wren ran the banners. Then Hattie ran the lanterns (clue 6), and red, barred from the choir and tickets (clues 1, 4), is hers.
Then navy must be the choir's (clue 3), and the 8:00 p.m. green coat has no job left. So Wren ran the lanterns.
Hattie ran the banners and still wore red (clues 1, 4, 6), so she took 7:00 p.m. Gideon took 8:00 p.m., in green.
Clue 4: green is not tickets, so Gideon ran the choir, Lena the tickets. Clue 3 puts Wren in navy; clue 8, Teddy in camel.
solution.epilogue: Teddy, in his camel coat and fresh from the cocoa table, snapped the 9:00 p.m. photo on the green, just as the light at Thimble Point went dark.
